sequence.description: Protein sequence to score (canonical 1-letter codes only). Used for sequence-only metrics (GRAVY, polybasic, instability index, pI).

pdb_path.description: Path to a structure file to score (PDB or mmCIF). Required for the `plddt` metric and for any structure-dependent QC checks.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` and/or `structure_path` when those direct inputs are omitted.

metrics.description: Which QC metrics to compute. `plddt` reads predicted-confidence from a structure; `polybasic` detects polybasic clusters; `gravy` is the Grand Average of Hydropathy; `instability_index` is the Guruprasad instability; `pi` is the isoelectric point.
